script_text: Your week takes a dramatic turn as hidden truths surface in your career and love. Saturday is your caution day — Mars through your 12th House signals emotional exhaustion, so prioritize rest. As a fire sign ruled by Mars, channel passion into one concrete goal and execute it before Thursday. Follow for daily updates.
